sources.title: Different terminal-depth and multi-readout objectives
sources.details: Let Lr=CE(H(sr),y). Fixed3 uses L3. Uniform sampling R in {1,3,5} has expectation (L1+L3+L5)/3; an all-depth objective uses sum_r a_r Lr and adds direct losses at intermediate readouts. These functions need not agree. Core forward calls per update are 3 versus sampled mean (1+3+5)/3=3 under this particular distribution; identical mean does not fix variance, backward truncation, number of heads/loss evaluations or wall time. T.10 calls these mechanism recipes, not measured completed product results.
